session_summary: Initial mentoring session focused on establishing a practical approach to language support without confirming external service eligibility. The student reported difficulty writing complete sentences and using formal language correctly.
primary_concern: Struggle with writing complete sentences, linking words, and uncertainty regarding when to use formal language in school contexts.

tracked_details.detail: Agreed between-session task: Write down two instruction words that appear in class.
External support eligibility check (school record or service availability).

next_steps: Student to attempt writing down two instruction words before the next session.
Mentor and student to identify a specific school contact to verify eligibility or confirm support availability.
uncertainties: Whether external support services are available or approved.
Exact dates of recent incidents affecting attendance or work completion.
Whether the agreed between-session task will be completed given time constraints.
conclusion: The initial session established a collaborative, non-judgmental approach. A specific language activity was attempted and found useful by the student, but external support delivery remains unverified. The main barrier (writing/formal language) persists as unresolved pending further intervention or eligibility confirmation.
